steps.title: Mass Casualty Event
steps.role: Starts the run when the crisis button is pressed.

steps.title: Hospital Engine
steps.role: SimPy model of the hospital: beds, nurses and patients over time.

steps.title: ER Agent
steps.role: Speaks for the emergency room only.

steps.title: Staffing Agent
steps.role: Tracks which nurses are free and when.

steps.title: Coordinator
steps.role: Listens to every department and makes one plan for the whole hospital.

steps.title: Bed Calculator
steps.role: Plain math, no AI. Finds a plan that breaks no rules.

steps.title: DeepChart Check
steps.role: Checks each transfer's reasons against the patient's records.

steps.title: Charge Nurse Review
steps.role: A person decides anything the system is unsure about.

steps.title: Simulated Outcome
steps.role: Runs the same hospital with and without this plan and compares waits.
